what: On open, the logo at the center of the full-screen curtain sharpens from a 50px blur, starting .6s late, at 1s, while a soft mask edge sweeps over the logo from left to right over 3.3s to reveal it. After 2.2s (and the signal to wait), a mask with a blurred-bottom gradient lifts the curtain from bottom to top over 3.9s (phone 3.6s) with cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1)

options.hold: Minimum seconds before it starts to lift, default 2.2 — shorten it for screens opened often, like in apps
options.wait: Name of a document event to wait for before lifting (e.g. hero video ready) — the curtain lifts only after both this and hold have passed
options.wait_max: Waits at most this long (sec) for wait, default 10
options.wipe: Curtain clear duration (seconds), default 3.9 · wipe_sp phone default 3.6
options.focus: Logo focus length (seconds), default 1 · focus_delay default .6
options.[data-fx-part=reveal]: Wrapper revealed by wiping left to right (child — if none, focus only without the wipe)
options.fx:closing·fx:done: Events the element emits when it starts clearing · when fully cleared (bubbling up to the document) — hook the Hero ripple (ripple-reveal wait) on fx:closing

from.where: index.html .h-loading (original .l-loading — is-start: logo mask 3.3s cubic(.76,0,.25,1)·focus 1s ease-out .6s, waits for 1.2s+1s and for the hero video to be ready, then is-closing: mask position 0→200% over 3.9s (phone 3.6s) cubic(.76,0,.24,1))

note: Curtain background is the consumer’s css (original is a dark night-brown gradient). Default is --kf-contrast-bg
